title: Total RNA Extraction, cDNA Synthesis, and qPCR for S100A6-siRNA
author: Shanshan Feng
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.mqec5te

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in a Petri dish using Trizol solution.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells twice with 1 × PBS.
Add 1 ml of Trizol solution and mix well.
Pipette mixture into a 1.5 ml RNase free EP tube.
Allow cells to lyse for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA phase using chloroform and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of chloroform to the centrifuge tube and shake vigorously for 30s.
Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12,000 rpm at 4 °C.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new RNase free EP tube.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol and mix gently.
Reverse 6-8 times and let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the RNA pellet.

steps.title: RNA Washing and Dissolution
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet and dissolve it in DEPC water.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet twice with 75% ethanol and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 min.
Add an appropriate amount of DEPC water to dissolve the precipitate.
Store at -80 °C for long-term preservation.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the extracted RNA by measuring the absorbance at 260 nm.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription using the Reverse Transcription cDNA kit (TransGen Biotech, Beijing, China) in a 20 μl reaction system.

substeps.instruction: First step (65°C 5min, then immediate cooling on ice 2min): Combine 50ng-5ug Total RNA, 0.5ul Oligo(dT)18 Primer (0.5ug/ul), and 0.5ul Random Primer (0.1ug/ul).
Second step (25°C 10 min, 42°C 15 min, 85°C 5 seconds): Add 10ul 2×TS Reaction Mix, 1ul RT/RI Enzyme Mix, 1ul gDNA Remover, and RNase-free Water to reach a total volume of 20 μl.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the 20 μl qPCR system on ice using SYBR® Select Master Mix (Life Technologies, USA).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μl cDNA mixture.
Add 10ul SYBR® Select Master Mix (2x).
Add 1 μl upstream primer (10 mM).
Add 1 μl downstream primer (10 mM).
Add RNase free water to reach a total volume of 20 μl.

steps.title: Run qPCR Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Execute the qPCR reaction according to the following thermal cycling procedure:

substeps.instruction: Step 1: 50°C for 2min.
Step 2: 95°C for 2 minutes, then 40 cycles of (95°C for 15 seconds and 60°C for 1 minute), followed by 60°C for 10 seconds.
Step 3: 72°C for 5 minutes.
Step 4: Hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Analyze Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Calculate relative gene expression by comparing the CT value of the gene of interest with that of GAPDH (internal control).
